name: Daisy Links – open links in new tab, add nofollow attribute, disable right click on links
author: DaisyPlugins

sections.description:
Daisy Links is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin that gives you complete control over your website’s link behavior. With three essential features, you can optimize external links for SEO, improve user experience, and protect your content with just a few clicks.

Features

🌼 Add Nofollow Attribute

  • Easily adds rel=”nofollow” to all external links
  • Helps control SEO link equity and prevent spam score
  • Simple toggle switch for instant activation

🌼 Open Links in New Tab

  • Forces all external links to open in new browser tabs
  • Keeps visitors engaged on your site while allowing external resources
  • Works globally across your entire website

🌼 Disable Right-Click on Links

  • Protects your links from being copied or inspected
  • Shows a default alert when users attempt to right-click
  • Ideal for affiliate links or premium content protection

Usage

Access Settings:
– Navigate to Daisy Links in your WordPress admin menu
– All features are accessible from the main settings page

Configure Options:
– Toggle each feature on/off as needed
– No additional configuration required
– Changes take effect immediately after saving

Enjoy Enhanced Control:
– All features work automatically in the background
– No coding or technical knowledge required
– Settings apply to both existing and new content

Daisy Links works out-of-the-box with any WordPress theme and maintains optimal performance even on large websites. All features are completely optional and can be used independently or together.

Support & Feedback 💬

If you have any questions, issues, or feature requests, feel free to reach out:
– Support Forum: Daisy Links Support
– GitHub Issues: Report an Issue

Contribute 🤝

We welcome contributions! If you’d like to contribute to Daisy Links, please:
1. Fork the repository on GitHub.
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bug fix.
3. Submit a pull request.

License 📜

Daisy Links is licensed under the GPLv2. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute it as per the license terms.

Thank You! ❤️

Thank you for choosing Daisy Links! We hope this plugin makes managing your external links a breeze. If you love Daisy Links, consider leaving a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review on the WordPress Plugin Repository.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Daisy Links.
  3. Install and activate the Daisy Links plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire daisy-links folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Daisy Links plugin.
sections.faq:
How to install and activate Daisy Links?

  1. Download the daisy-links.zip file from the WordPress plugin repository or your source.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the daisy-links.zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.
